prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too optimistic for high forecasts, whereas zero or negative predictions underpredicted major wins.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) were generally helpful, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+4.6% and +6.6%), though one test performed worse (-4.6%).
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across both of its tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced inconsistent results, winning in 2 tests (+6.1% and +4.7%) while performing worse in 2 others (-4.3% and -9.2%).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout (1 win, 1 no clear effect) and all single-test categories, as at least 2 agreeing tests are needed to establish a pattern.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Persistence Hint: Adds an explanatory hint on the sign-in screen confirming that signing in protects saved pets from resetting across app restarts. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back into an account.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Stage Grid Redesign: Replaces the default pet selection list with a clear grid view featuring highlight badges for companion traits. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the early flow at 72.7% with a mean time of 1017s. A structured grid speeds up selection.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Preview Screen: Inserts a dedicated preview screen after photo upload so users can inspect image clarity before final adoption. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output due to photo issues.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Processing Info: Displays an explanatory status hint reassuring users that pet assets are preparing seamlessly in the background. (why: The waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty about app responsiveness.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Welcome Redesign: Redesigns the final welcome screen into a split view highlighting fundamental desktop pet interaction tips. (why: Finish conversion drops to 68.0% and support received 3 complaints regarding confusion on how to control or hide pets post-onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Clarity Headline Update: Updates the choose path headline and body text to clearly distinguish between preset library pets and custom creations. (why: High mean time (514s) on choose_path suggests hesitation between available path choices.)
6: [adoption, hint] Certificate Official Adoption Record Hint: Adds a hint on the adoption certificate screen emphasizing that registration creates a permanent digital pet record. (why: Adoption completion is only 72.7%. Reinforcing ownership value encourages users to complete adoption.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Launch Completion Button Copy: Changes the primary action button label on the final screen to action-oriented text. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 27.0%, with a 32.0% drop at the final completion step.)
8: [home, new_flow] Desktop Launch Verification Flow: Adds a verification step right before home intro to check that the desktop pet window renders properly. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting that pets do not show on the desktop or the app fails to open after onboarding.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints have strong historical performance (+2.2% avg, 2/3 wins) and both funnel drop and 8 support tickets confirm user confusion.
Adoption step has high drop-off, but adoption redesigns have performed inconsistently across 4 tests with a slightly negative mean.
Targeted support issues exist, but adding new screens typically introduces significant funnel friction (e.g. -15.2% on finish).
Long duration at home step indicates hesitation, but wait_info changes showed no clear strong effect across past 2 tests (+1.7% avg).
Finish step has the largest drop-off (32%) and direct support complaints; redesign carries some risk but addresses clear onboarding confusion.
Choose_path has low drop-off and copy changes in this category previously showed a negative result (-3.0%).
Adoption step drop-off is high, but adoption hints underperformed in prior testing (-4.6%).
Finish step drop is severe (32%); low-cost copy change showed minor positive lift (+0.9%) in past test.
Solves reported rendering issues, but adding a full new verification flow adds drop-off risk (home new_flow historical: -2.2%).
